note: Hand-traced fallback geometry for the five roster off-street trails. Written because this build environment's egress policy blocks the Overpass API (see pull_osm_trails.py), so the OSM pull cannot run. Vertices were placed from editorial knowledge of the corridors and are approximate (roughly 100-300 m tolerance) — good enough for the network map's schematic route view, NOT survey-grade. Provenance: data_tier 'crowdsourced', like the mellow routes. aggregate.py prefers a real raw/osm_trails.json over this file whenever one exists; delete nothing here to upgrade — just run the OSM pull in an environment that allows it.
